presets.name: Archive
presets.description: Prioritizes long-term storage efficiency while preserving visual and audio quality. Encoding speed is less important than compression efficiency.

image.info: Excellent compression, supports HDR, metadata, animation, and future-proof archival storage.

video.info: Industry-leading compression efficiency for archival video collections.

audio.info: Preserves original audio quality while reducing storage requirements.

presets.name: Streaming
presets.description: Optimized for Plex, Jellyfin, smart TVs, mobile devices, and broad hardware compatibility.

image.info: Efficient image format with widespread browser and application support.

video.info: Excellent hardware decoding support and commonly direct-plays on media server clients.

audio.info: Highly compatible audio codec supported by nearly all devices.

presets.name: Modern Streaming
presets.description: Targets newer devices and software with support for next-generation codecs.

image.info: Better compression than traditional web formats while maintaining high image quality.

video.info: Superior compression efficiency with growing hardware support.

audio.info: Excellent audio quality at low bitrates and ideal for streaming.

presets.name: Space Saver
presets.description: Aggressively reduces storage usage while maintaining acceptable playback quality.

image.info: Strong image compression focused on minimizing file size.

video.info: Maximizes space savings with reduced bitrate targets.

audio.info: Retains good listening quality while minimizing storage usage.

presets.name: Compatibility
presets.description: Designed for maximum playback support across older devices, browsers, and software.

video.info: Most widely supported video codec available.

audio.info: Broad support across operating systems and media players.

presets.name: Lossless Archive
presets.description: Preserves all source data without quality loss, prioritizing fidelity over storage efficiency.

image.info: Retains original image data while reducing storage requirements.

video.info: Archival-grade lossless video compression suitable for preservation.

audio.info: Bit-perfect audio preservation with reduced file size.

presets.name: Keep Original Codec
presets.description: Preserves the source codec and only re-encodes when a format is unsupported or explicitly requested.

video.info: Skips transcoding when no significant benefit is expected.

audio.info: Prevents quality degradation from lossy-to-lossy conversions.
